openrouter.provider_statement: The Free Models Router openrouter/free has zero prompt and completion token pricing.

nvidia.provider_statement: NVIDIA states that Developer Program members get free access to NVIDIA-hosted NIM API endpoints for prototyping. That provider-global statement and successful authentication do not by themselves prove that a concrete credential is currently covered by the free entitlement.
nvidia.credential_binding_observation: The candidate fingerprint was materialized by the sandbox credential inventory and authenticated successfully against integrate.api.nvidia.com hosted NIM routes. It remains non-authoritative economic identity until fresh provider-side entitlement evidence is bound.
nvidia.credential_plan_proof: Require a fresh NVIDIA_CREDENTIAL_FREE_ENTITLEMENT_RECEIPT/v1 keyed by the exact credential fingerprint, with provider=nvidia, endpoint_host=integrate.api.nvidia.com, provider_side_zero_cost_confirmed=true, evidence_ref, entitlement_evidence_digest, observed_at, valid_until and exact allowed_models. Fingerprint presence, successful HTTP authentication and public documentation are supporting evidence only.
nvidia.scope: NVIDIA-hosted API Catalog/NIM prototyping endpoint only; no dedicated enterprise endpoint

groq.credential_plan_proof: A historical or live response for the same credential fingerprint and exact model must expose x-ratelimit-limit-requests and x-ratelimit-limit-tokens matching the documented Free Plan limits.

mistral.provider_statement: Mistral Free mode includes API usage; API keys themselves are not plan-scoped and can also use pay-as-you-go settings.
mistral.credential_plan_proof: Require provider-side Free-mode/pay-as-you-go-disabled evidence bound to the organization/workspace before autonomous calls. Ordinary key presence or HTTP 402 is insufficient.
